title: "Pre-course instructions"
toc: true
toc-location: right
---

To participate in this course, you will need a computer with internet
access and a web browser.

You do **not** need to install any software. We will use GitHub, a free
website, to store and edit all of our files, and GitHub will build and
publish our website for us.

If you are using a computer provided by your organisation you may find
that some websites are blocked. Please check Step 1 below before the
course. If GitHub is blocked, you could use a personal computer instead.

## Step 1: Check your browser and connection

You can use any recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

1.  Open your browser and go to <https://github.com/>
2.  Check that the page loads and you can see a "Sign up" button
    in the top right corner.

If the page does not load, please contact your IT department or
the course organisers before the course.

## Step 2: Decide which email address to use

To use GitHub you need a free GitHub account and to confirm it by email.
During the course you will sign up in one of three ways. Decide now which
one you would like to use:

1.  **A Google account.** You will click "Continue with Google" and sign
    in as you normally do.
2.  **A Microsoft email address.** For example, an Outlook or Hotmail
    address, or your work or school address if it is a Microsoft one. You
    will type this address into the GitHub sign-up form.
3.  **Any other email address.** You will type this address into the
    GitHub sign-up form.

Whichever you choose, make sure that you can open the inbox for that
address during the course, because GitHub will send you a code to confirm
that the address is yours.

💡 If you use a work or university address, think about what will happen
when you leave. A personal address means you will not lose access to your
website when you change jobs.

## Step 3: Arrange your screen

During the course you will switch between this course website and GitHub.
It helps to have the course website open in one browser window and GitHub in
another, side by side, if your screen is big enough. Otherwise, use two tabs.

## Step 4: Create your account early (optional)

If you would like to get ahead, you can create your GitHub account before
the course by following Part 1 of the [Materials](materials.qmd). If you
do, please remember your username and how you signed up. You will need
both again during the course.
